description.text: Teaching Objective The program aims to produce highly-qualified dentists that possess systematic stomatological knowledge, clinical skills, and innovative techniques. Duration 5 years

duration.text: The Oral Medicine at Dalian Medical University is a 5 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 5555 USD/per year ￥ 40000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 2. Graduation certificate of high school Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 3. Academic transcript of high school 4. Photocopy of 1st page to 8th page of your valid passport (Liaoning) With photo, passport number & expiration date and name included. For the regarding authority must make sure that there are at least two pages on the passport for the Chinese Embassy to stick the Visa paper and Immigration to stick the resident permit paper 5.HSK Certificate (No need for English-taught program)

requirements.text: 1.Applicant should be between 18 and 25 2.Applicant should hold high school graduation or equivalent to a Chinese high school graduate
